name: Ofia: PDF & Document Creator
description:
Ofia turns a prompt, notes or uploaded files into a polished PDF and an editable project you can continue working on. It is built for technical documents that need more than standard word processing, including research papers, mathematical notes, reports, proposals, technical briefs and business plans.

Claude can create and revise documents, organise project files, upload figures, manage multi-file LaTeX projects and compile publication-quality PDFs. Ofia handles equations, references, tables, diagrams and complex layouts while keeping the underlying source available for future edits.

Use Ofia when you want to turn rough material into a finished technical document without writing LaTeX yourself.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ofia: PDF & Document Creator to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ofia: PDF & Document Creator to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ofia.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ofia: PDF & Document Creator MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ofia: PDF & Document Creator provides these MCP tools: compile_pdf, create_document, create_project, get_account, get_pdf_link, list_projects, read_file, revise_document, upload_file, and write_file.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ofia: PDF & Document Creator?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ofia: PDF & Document Creator in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Ofia: PDF & Document Creator MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ofia: PDF & Document Creator requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Ofia: PDF & Document Creator?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ofia: PDF & Document Creator is developed by SpinOr Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
